definitions.explanation: Tools and equipment used in farming and agriculture, such as hoes, sickles, plows, and rakes. Includes both traditional hand tools and modern implements.

examples.japanese: {農具|のうぐ}を{倉庫|そうこ}にしまった。
examples.english: I put the farming tools away in the shed.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{農具|のうぐ}が{博物館|はくぶつかん}に{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: Old farming tools are displayed in the museum.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{農具|のうぐ}の{手入|てい}れを{欠|か}かさなかった。
examples.english: My grandfather never neglected the maintenance of his farming tools.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in agricultural, historical, and museum contexts. Traditional Japanese {農具|のうぐ} like {鎌|かま} (sickle), {鍬|くわ} (hoe), and {鋤|すき} (plow) are important cultural artifacts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農具|のうぐ}を{使|つか}う (to use farming tools)
- {農具|のうぐ}の{手入|てい}れ (maintenance of farming tools)
- {伝統的|でんとうてき}な{農具|のうぐ} (traditional farming implements)
- {農具|のうぐ}{小屋|ごや} (tool shed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {工具|こうぐ}: tools — general tools for construction or repair work
- {道具|どうぐ}: implements, tools — the broadest general term for tools of any kind
